goal: Fix the gemma-4-12B hybrid-iswa paged-attn bug so the paged path produces correct output on hybrid models (base/SWA split with different head dims). Wave 4 fixed non-hybrid (qwen 3%->100%); gemma (hybrid) was still 1-3%.

genes.approach: Pass v_trans explicitly to ggml_tessera_paged_attn instead of inferring it from tensor shapes. The shape inference (v->ne[0] == k->ne[2]) is ambiguous when the V head dimension equals the KV arena size, which is exactly the case for the gemma SWA cache (head_dim=256, padded n_kv=256): the op wrongly picked the transposed-V access pattern while the cache stores V non-transposed, reading V at wrong offsets and producing garbage from decode step 1.
touched_regions: ggml/src/ggml.c:ggml_tessera_paged_attn (drop shape inference, use caller param)
genes.verdict_reason: Root-caused and fixed the hybrid-iswa paged bug. gemma-4-12B f16 paged now matches flash_attn_ext byte-identically (3.8pct -> 100pct, two prompts/seeds). qwen2.5-0.5B (non-hybrid) stays 100pct. ctest + backend op tests pass. The fix is a one-line semantic change (thread v_trans explicitly) that removes a fundamentally broken shape-based inference; it cannot regress non-hybrid models because for them head_dim != n_kv so the old inference happened to be correct, and the new path uses the same authoritative value the caller already had.
